prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1459; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the parking lot collision described in the enclosed materials. Please direct all future communications regarding this matter to our firm and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Our client has sustained injuries that require ongoing medical evaluation and treatment, and we are gathering the documentation needed to present a full claim.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page and a statement confirming whether any other coverage applies. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this loss.

Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, vehicle data, repair estimates, adjuster notes, witness statements, and any recorded communications. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials while the claim is pending. We look forward to your prompt written response.
